protocol.primary_endpoint: Original development joint accuracy at 130000 observations; each group requires both query targets under both fact assignments.
protocol.secondary_endpoints: Original training fit, expanded-training monitor, unconstrained exact answer generation, earlier-reader loss, exposure and live runtime.
protocol.comparisons: Both arms resume the same exact learned reading checkpoint per seed. Learning updates, replay slots/updates and speech counts match. Source volume, vocabulary, repetition and target-byte exposure can differ. No checkpoint selection.
protocol.monitor: Preselected 432-group sample of expanded training; never full expanded-training accuracy.
protocol.timing: Sum of live continuation segments after the common ancestor; includes replay, speech, logging and checkpoint I/O. Excludes setup and held-out evaluation.
